name: hackprinceton
description: A hackathon project for building energy analysis: a Python FastAPI backend (data layer for CoStar, Matterport, Vexcel, weather and tariffs; physics/solar/finance analysis; a LangGraph-based agent; legal drafting) with a React + Three.js frontend, coordinated by a GitHub-issue message board that lets teammates' coding agents hand off work. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
